# Tailnote

> Tailnote — Turn every email into a marketing moment. Email signature software for teams: on-brand signatures, promotional content blocks in every email, UTM link tracking, click analytics, curated signature layouts, and copy-paste install for Gmail and Outlook.

Canonical site: https://tailnote.com

## What Tailnote does

- Organization-wide email signature management for employees
- Promotional blocks (buttons, offers, blog feeds, banners) inside signatures
- Signature layouts designed for Gmail, Outlook, and common email clients
- Built-in UTM parameters and optional per-link click analytics
- Stripe billing: monthly, annual, and Lifetime (one-time) plans
- Free Email Health tool at /email-health: SPF checker, DKIM checker, DMARC checker, BIMI checker, email trust score, domain email health, email deliverability audit, and guidance on why emails go to spam

## Who it is for

Marketing, sales, and operations teams that want every outbound email to carry consistent branding and measurable calls to action without hand-editing HTML.

## Pricing

Paid SaaS per organization. Plans include a set number of users; see /pricing for current options including Lifetime one-time purchases.
